text:
amanda: Heads-up 1 we keep seeing confusion in SDKs about 409/conflict vs retryable errors. Proposal: extend canonical error shape to include idempotency/conflict fields so sample apps and SDKs can handle safe retries and conflict UIs consistently.
jason: Yes please. 409 is tricky: sometimes a retry is safe (idempotent ops), sometimes you should surface a merge/conflict resolution flow. We need explicit signals.
priya: Proposed additional fields: `idempotent`: true|false|null, `operation_id`: string|null (server-provided canonical op id), `conflict_type`: namespaced code (e.g., `object.version_mismatch`), `conflict_hint`: short string for sample UI (e.g., "retry_with_backoff", "resolve_merge"), plus keep `retryable` and `retry_after`.
lucas: SDK behavior suggestion: parse into a typed IdempotencyConflict exception for 409 with properties `operation_id`, `conflict_type`, `conflict_hint`, `idempotent`. Provide helpers: `.isIdempotent()` and `.recommendedAction()` returning one of ["retry","refresh","resolve","contact_support"].
emily: Sample app UX: if `conflict_hint` == "retry_with_backoff" show a small "Retry" CTA; if `resolve_merge` show a modal to merge changes. Keep `user_message` short. Avoid exposing internal `message` unless verbose mode requested.
amanda: Example verbose conflict payload (for docs): ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "object.version_mismatch",
    "status": 409,
    "message": "client revision 43 != server revision 44 for object 0xabc",
    "user_message": "Update conflict: someone else edited this item.",
    "idempotent": false,
    "operation_id": "op_01EXAMPLE",
    "conflict_type": "object.version_mismatch",
    "conflict_hint": "resolve_merge",
    "retryable": false,
    "meta": { "docs_url": "https://redwood.ai/errors#object.version_mismatch" }
  }
}```
priya: And a safe-retry example for idempotent create-with-client-id: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "request.duplicate",
    "status": 409,
    "message": "duplicate request with client-provided id=xyz",
    "user_message": "Duplicate request detected; the original request succeeded.",
    "idempotent": true,
    "operation_id": "op_01SAME",
    "conflict_hint": "retry_return_existing",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 0
  }
}```
jason: Love it. Important: SDKs must not infer idempotency from status alone. If `idempotent=true` then `.shouldRetry()` can return true and optionally return the existing resource if `operation_id` maps back to it.
lucas: Add to mapping docs: default for 409 is `retryable=false` unless `retryable=true` or `idempotent=true` present. Also include guidance on idempotency-key header semantics in the docs.
emily: Sample apps should show `user_message` and map `conflict_hint` to CTAs. For instance: `retry_return_existing` -> show "Show existing", `resolve_merge` -> show "Open merge". Keep copy short.
amanda: Implementation plan: API team adds fields (`idempotent`, `operation_id`, `conflict_type`, `conflict_hint`) and preserves compact/verbose header behavior. DevEx will add sample-app CTA mapping and docs examples. SDKs implement IdempotencyConflict typed exception and parity tests.
priya: I'll draft the API PR today. Ill include canonical examples above and compact-mode equivalents (compact omits `message` and `meta`).
jason: SDK leads: add unit tests that assert 409 with idempotent=true -> typed exception where `.isIdempotent()` is true and `.shouldRetry()` returns true. Also test 409 with `conflict_hint=resolve_merge` -> `.recommendedAction() == "resolve"`.
amanda: Timeline: land API + docs this sprint; SDK parity tests next sprint.
ci-bot: CI: sample-apps/test-suite failed on sdk-go parity test for error-shape (see https://ci.redwood.internal/77777). Could be related to missing `conflict_hint` parsing.
lucas: I'll take the failing Go test. Likely we didn't parse `operation_id` in a nested field earlier.
emily: I'll add the CTA mapping table to the DevEx docs and update the sample app UX to use `conflict_hint`.
priya: PR draft up in a branch `api/error-conflict-fields`  will ping reviewers @jason @amanda.
jason: I'll review and add test vectors to the parity harness. Also suggest adding a short section about idempotency-key header semantics in the API docs.
amanda: Thanks. Small UX constraint: `conflict_hint` strings should be stable and namespaced, keep them machine-friendly. e.g., `conflict.retry_return_existing`, `conflict.resolve_merge`.
priya: noted  will use namespaced values in the PR.
amanda: Great. Keep this thread updated if any SDK lead hits ambiguity. Goal: land the schema plus examples this sprint. :rocket:
